newsitem.title: USA: Laserscope says FDA okays laser system.
newsitem.headline: Laserscope says FDA okays laser system.

text.p: Laserscope Inc on Wednesday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared the company's new Erbium:YAG laser system for sale in the United States.

NWL Laser-Technologie GmbH,a German manufacturer, makes the laser system, and Laserscope holds a 32 percent stake in the company. Laserscope said it expects to increase its interest to a majority position in 1997's third quarter.
The Erbium:YAG laser can be used for surgical incision and excision, vaporization and coagulation of soft tissue.
Laserscope shares were up 9/16 to 7-13/16 by mid-afternoon.
